parsed.why: Statutory single-sex code in force, birth-sex strip-search and custody placement, hospital ward bans unremedied — universal tier-1 exposures reaching every outed visitor; no criminalisation, functioning courts, but no relief shown for those institutional rules.

Self-ID law, equal-treatment act, hate-crime support and acceptance outweigh exposures: binary prison placement exceptional only, private sauna guideline, one unresolved airport screening complaint. No criminalisation or organised targeting; remedies function unevenly.

Sodomy offences carrying lashing and death, security forces arresting suspected trans people, official advisory banning trans presence from busy areas, custodial rape and forced examinations, recognition only after surgery — state-tolerated targeting with no protections.

Cross-dressing offence struck down 2022, but dress policing and official discrimination persisted, enforced same-sex conduct law with imprisonment, no protections or civil society, censorship — hostility with thin recourse and open enforcement questions.

Documented killings and police extortion with impunity and unenforced rights weigh heavily, but counts lack denominators; counterweights are nationwide marriage equality, transfemicide law, constitutional protections, acceptance and Pride in hubs — no visitor-facing universal ban.
